note: Curated set, shown one at a time while a transcript loads. Taste: one-line reversals that catch the reader out; clear thinking, attention, and jabs at power and rules; stoics, plain-spoken scientists and the downtown text-art / street-art scene. Keep each under about 120 characters, with a source that can be checked. Mark source as 'attributed' when no primary source exists. No song lyrics.

quotes.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
The first principle is that you must not fool yourself—and you are the easiest person to fool.
Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
It is difficult to get a man to understand something, when his salary depends upon his not understanding it.
It is impossible for a man to begin to learn what he thinks he knows.
The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
The greatest crimes in the world are not committed by people breaking the rules but by people following the rules.
Abuse of power comes as no surprise.
Be realistic, demand the impossible.
A wealth of information creates a poverty of attention.
quotes.source: Designing Organizations for an Information-Rich World, 1971

quotes.text: Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.
I can resist everything except temptation.
Attention is the beginning of devotion.
We all have strength enough to endure the misfortunes of others.
I love deadlines. I love the whooshing noise they make as they go by.
Everybody has plans until they get hit for the first time.
Art is for everybody.
I don't think about art while I work. I try to think about life.
Not everything that is faced can be changed; but nothing can be changed until it is faced.
They always say that time changes things, but you actually have to change them yourself.
If they can get you asking the wrong questions, they don't have to worry about the answers.
Sorry! The lifestyle you ordered is currently out of stock.
The best revenge is not to be like your enemy.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.source: On the Shortness of Life (tr. Costa)

quotes.text: What upsets people is not things themselves but their judgments about the things.
One who knows does not speak. One who speaks does not know.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
The reason we have two ears and only one mouth is that we may listen more and talk less.
All the unhappiness of men arises from one single fact, that they cannot stay quietly in their own chamber.
I have made this one longer only because I have not had the leisure to make it shorter.
Doubt is not a pleasant condition, but certainty is absurd.
quotes.source: letter to Frederick William of Prussia, 1770

quotes.text: If we have our own why of life, we shall get along with almost any how.
I say, beware of all enterprises that require new clothes, and not rather a new wearer of clothes.
It is not enough to be industrious; so are the ants. What are you industrious about?
Therefore all progress depends on the unreasonable man.
A book must be the axe for the frozen sea inside us.
One must imagine Sisyphus happy.
Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
To see what is in front of one's nose needs a constant struggle.
We are what we pretend to be, so we must be careful about what we pretend to be.
Reality is that which, when you stop believing in it, doesn't go away.
quotes.source: How to Build a Universe That Doesn't Fall Apart Two Days Later, 1978

quotes.text: The truth does not change according to our ability to stomach it emotionally.
quotes.source: letter, 1955, in The Habit of Being

quotes.text: Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence.
Ignorance more frequently begets confidence than does knowledge.
In the modern world the stupid are cocksure while the intelligent are full of doubt.
There is always a well-known solution to every human problem — neat, plausible, and wrong.
Tell all the Truth but tell it slant
First forget inspiration. Habit is more dependable.
Think before you speak. Read before you think.
When the going gets weird, the weird turn pro.
Protect me from what I want.
Use what is dominant in a culture to change it quickly.
I shop therefore I am.
Belief + Doubt = Sanity
If graffiti changed anything it would be illegal.
Under the paving stones, the beach!
In the future everybody will be world famous for fifteen minutes.
I can't understand why people are frightened of new ideas. I'm frightened of the old ones.
Honour thy error as a hidden intention.
Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
Information wants to be free.
Power concedes nothing without a demand.
The master's tools will never dismantle the master's house.
We live in capitalism. Its power seems inescapable; so did the divine right of kings.
The function of freedom is to free someone else.
The future is already here. It's just not evenly distributed.
It's easier to ask forgiveness than it is to get permission.
quotes.source: attributed; an older saying she made famous

quotes.text: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
We shape our tools and thereafter they shape us.
Good design is as little design as possible.
The medium is the message.
The limits of my language mean the limits of my world.
Whereof one cannot speak, thereof one must be silent.
Words, words, words.
Verba volant, scripta manent.
quotes.source: spoken words fly away, written words remain

quotes.text: What is written without effort is in general read without pleasure.
Be sincere; be brief; be seated.
It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation.
Nothing so aggravates an earnest person as a passive resistance.
Ah Bartleby! Ah humanity!
